purpose: Independently test whether the historical I4C candidate screenplay shows a broader multi-dimensional craft deficit in middle/late episode positions than in early positions, without reusing the 12 original Stage-B comparison scenes or their winner labels.
source_cutoff: sealed I4C_R2_FINAL_SCREENPLAY_R1 only; no R4A material; no historical Stage-B rationales inside evaluator packets
eligible_scenes: I4C R2 S01-S50 excluding original Stage-B scene ids S03,S07,S11,S14,S19,S21,S28,S33,S37,S41,S45,S50

sample_rule.selection: sample 4 eligible scene ids independently within each stratum, then sort selected scene ids numerically for extraction
sample_rule.packet_order: shuffle the 12 selected scenes and assign opaque ids AP01-AP12; mapping kept separate until all valid responses are sealed

frozen_axes.DIALOGUE_SUBTEXT: literal/explanatory dialogue versus implication, avoidance, humor, indirect emotional information or subtext
frozen_axes.CHARACTER_VOICE: speaker-specific diction, rhythm, occupational/life language and differentiated verbal identity
frozen_axes.RELATIONSHIP_STATUS_PRESSURE: trust, hierarchy, power, status movement and relational pressure embedded in scene behavior/dialogue
frozen_axes.PHYSICALIZATION_ACTION: dramatic action, props, blocking, work process, command/action simultaneity rather than explanation
frozen_axes.PACING_ESCALATION_TIME_PRESSURE: scene-goal pressure, compression, escalation, countdown/immediacy and end pressure
frozen_axes.ENSEMBLE_WORLD_SPECIFICITY: distinct ensemble functions, world/occupation specificity, group rhythm and non-generic texture
frozen_axes.INFORMATION_REVEAL_IRREVERSIBILITY: reversal, disclosure, surprise, trust collapse or irreversible informational/emotional turn
frozen_axes.LINE_ECONOMY_RHYTHM: line economy, compactness, purposeful repetition, question/avoidance rhythm and removal of verbal overhead

annotation_contract.per_scene_output: 8 axis severities plus one concise evidence note naming observable text/behavior only; no chain-of-thought

derived_metrics.scene_breadth: count of axes whose cross-evaluator median severity >=1
derived_metrics.scene_material_breadth: count of axes whose cross-evaluator median severity >=2
derived_metrics.scene_severity_sum: sum of cross-evaluator median severities across 8 axes

decision_rule.POSITIVE_MIXED_CRAFT_POSITIONAL_REPLICAT: after all 3 valid responses are sealed and mapping is opened once: (middle+late pooled mean breadth >= early mean breadth + 1.0) AND (middle+late pooled mean severity >= early mean severity + 2.0) AND at least 2/3 evaluators individually show middle+late mean raw severity > early mean raw severity
decision_rule.MIXED_OR_WEAK_REPLICATION: direction is middle+late worse on at least one aggregate metric but full positive threshold is not met, or evaluator direction agreement <2/3
decision_rule.NO_POSITIONAL_REPLICATION: middle+late is not worse than early on either aggregate breadth or aggregate severity

valid_response_rule: all 12 opaque scene ids present exactly once, all 8 axes integer 0-2, evidence note present, evaluator/provider identity metadata present, independence attestation present; malformed response may be replaced only before mapping open and without inspecting partial aggregate outcome
guardrails: no use of original 12 Stage-B scenes in primary replication sample
no R4A mapping or surface access
no renderer intervention from packet construction alone
no mapping open before three valid responses are sealed
no threshold changes after any response is seen
next_legal_action: mechanically sample eligible scene ids by frozen seeds; extract exact sealed scenes; build opaque annotation packet and separate mapping; hash/seal both; if independent evaluator execution unavailable stop at PACKETS_SEALED__RESPONSES_0__MAPPING_CLOSED
